remarks: Very unique - this totally redone one family has a 2 Bedroom inlaw apartment with separate entrance. Finished Lower Level with access to fenced in backyard. (Please note - new driveway will be done by end of March and also a new fence will be put installed next to driveway.) Beautiful brand new granite kitchen with new Stainless Steel appliances. Laundry Room with new washer/dryer and beautiful new bathrooms as well. Lovely third floor primary bedroom with ensuite bath.  Gas Heat and cooking. Central Air. Hardwood floors  Convenient to Beach, parks, shopping and I-95. Note: Lots of little touchups to be done by owner before closing - such as front porch painting, around the house painting touch ups, new lawn, etc.
